cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
infile <- args[[1]]
outfile <- args[[2]]
xml_unescape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub('<', '<', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('>', '>', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', '"', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(''', "'", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('&', '&', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}
workdir <- tempfile('xlsx_')
dir.create(workdir)
utils::unzip(infile, files = c('xl/sharedStrings.xml', 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'), exdir = workdir)
read_zip_text <- function(member) {
  paste(readLines(file.path(workdir, member), warn = FALSE), collapse = '')
}
extract_matches <- function(pattern, text) {
  m <- gregexpr(pattern, text, perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (identical(m, -1L)) character(0) else regmatches(text, list(m))[[1]]
}
shared_xml <- read_zip_text('xl/sharedStrings.xml')
si_nodes <- extract_matches('<si[^>]*>.*?</si>', shared_xml)
shared <- vapply(si_nodes, function(si) {
  t_nodes <- extract_matches('<t[^>]*>.*?</t>', si)
  txt <- gsub('<[^>]+>', '', t_nodes, perl = TRUE)
  xml_unescape(paste(txt, collapse = ''))
}, character(1))
sheet_xml <- read_zip_text('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml')
cell_nodes <- extract_matches('<c[^>]*>.*?</c>', sheet_xml)
col_to_int <- function(s) {
  letters <- strsplit(s, '', fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  sum((match(letters, LETTERS)) * 26 ^ rev(seq_along(letters) - 1L))
}
refs <- sub('.*r="([A-Z]+[0-9]+)".*', '\\1', cell_nodes, perl = TRUE)
row_nums <- as.integer(gsub('[A-Z]+', '', refs))
col_labs <- gsub('[0-9]+', '', refs)
col_nums <- vapply(col_labs, col_to_int, integer(1))
values <- vapply(cell_nodes, function(cell) {
  if (grepl('<v[^>]*>', cell, perl = TRUE)) {
    v <- sub('.*<v[^>]*>(.*?)</v>.*', '\\1', cell, perl = TRUE)
  } else if (grepl('<t[^>]*>', cell, perl = TRUE)) {
    v <- gsub('<[^>]+>', '', paste(extract_matches('<t[^>]*>.*?</t>', cell), collapse = ''), perl = TRUE)
  } else {
    v <- ''
  }
  if (grepl('t="s"', cell, fixed = TRUE) && nzchar(v)) {
    return(shared[as.integer(v) + 1L])
  }
  xml_unescape(v)
}, character(1))
mat <- matrix('', nrow = max(row_nums), ncol = max(col_nums))
for (i in seq_along(values)) mat[row_nums[i], col_nums[i]] <- values[i]
headers <- make.names(mat[1, ], unique = TRUE)
dat <- as.data.frame(mat[-1, , drop = FALSE], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(dat) <- headers
age_col <- grep('^Age$', names(dat), value = TRUE)
eff_col <- grep('^Efficacy$', names(dat), value = TRUE)
if (length(age_col) != 1L || length(eff_col) != 1L) stop('Could not identify Age and Efficacy columns')
age <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat[[age_col]]))
eff <- toupper(trimws(dat[[eff_col]]))
y <- ifelse(eff %in% c('CR', 'PR'), 1, ifelse(eff %in% c('SD', 'PD'), 0, NA))
model_dat <- data.frame(y = y, age = age)
model_dat <- model_dat[complete.cases(model_dat), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(model_dat) < 2L || length(unique(model_dat$y)) != 2L) stop('Insufficient complete binary response data')
fit <- glm(y ~ age, data = model_dat, family = binomial(link = 'logit'))
coefs <- summary(fit)$coefficients
answer <- unname(coef(fit)['age'])
counts <- table(factor(model_dat$y, levels = c(0, 1)))
lines <- c(
  paste('estimand', 'logit responder(CR_or_PR) versus nonresponder(SD_or_PD), predictor Age', sep='\t'),
  paste('n_complete', nrow(model_dat), sep='\t'),
  paste('n_nonresponders', unname(counts[['0']]), sep='\t'),
  paste('n_responders', unname(counts[['1']]), sep='\t'),
  paste('intercept', format(coef(fit)[['(Intercept)']], digits=17, scientific=TRUE), sep='\t'),
  paste('age', format(answer, digits=17, scientific=TRUE), sep='\t'),
  paste('age_se', format(coefs['age', 'Std. Error'], digits=17, scientific=TRUE), sep='\t')
)
writeLines(lines, outfile)
RSCRIPT
